results.fact: route length and pitch count vs the pitches the overview describes
results.evidence: The route's listing gives 800 ft and 5 pitches; the route begins partway up Brain Freeze (an 8-pitch, 1000 ft line), so the stored length and pitch count include the shared lower pitches while the overview only details the three pitches of the route proper (170, 150, 100 ft). Stored 244 m matches the listed 800 ft. No second independent source found in 3 searches; nothing to change.

The route page offers two descents: the southeast gully to Black Lake (may need rappels), or climb west to the low point of the ridge between Arrowhead and McHenrys and drop back to the Solitude Lake cirque. The row's two fields are those two options, not a conflict.

This record is the crag-level entry for a trio of adjacent one-pitch 200 ft lines; its listed 600 ft (183 m) and 3 pitches are the three lines together, as the overview states. Stored values match the listing; no per-route figure to substitute without splitting the record.

results.fact: which side of the buttress the start is on
results.evidence: The route description says to aim for the western edge of the 3rd Buttress, which forms the right skyline of the north face, and that the P2 V-groove is close to but still on the eastern edge of that skyline. Approach and overview describe the same spot from different reference frames (buttress vs skyline).

The listing gives 800 ft, 4 pitches; the four described pitches (100+120+150+85 ft) are only the difficulties, and the description adds continued easy snow to the shoulder near the summit, accounting for the rest. Stored 244 m matches 800 ft.

The route's listing gives 400 ft (121 m), 2 pitches, with 150 ft pitches described, so the header length is slightly more than the pitches (likely includes ground between).
